aggregate.label: Northbound — foreign money into A-shares
aggregate.note: Aggregate northbound net disclosure ended 2024-08-16 (Stock Connect home-market rule) — historical only, no live velocity.
aggregate.note_zh: 北向资金净额披露于2024-08-16停止（互联互通本地市场规则）——仅历史，无实时流速。

ashare_names.note: 主力 net-rate (super-large + large orders); velocity = the 4-week inflow rate standardized against the name's OWN trailing norm (not against zero — main money is a structural net seller), acceleration = its trend.
ashare_names.note_zh: 主力净占比（超大单+大单）；流速＝4周流入率相对该股自身常态的标准化值（非相对零——主力资金结构性净卖出），加速度＝其趋势。

ashare_sectors.note: Per-sector big-money flow = equal-weight member main-money net-rate, ranked by 4-week velocity vs the sector's own trailing norm. Expand a sector for its biggest-moving member names.
ashare_sectors.note_zh: 板块主力资金＝等权成分股主力净占比，按4周流速（相对板块自身常态）排序。展开板块查看流向最强的成分股。

hk_names.note: Per HK name: how much of it the mainland Connect crowd holds (% of free float) and whether it is ADDING (5-/10-day change in holding value). HK's dominant marginal buyer — a flow confirmer for sizing, not a standalone alpha.

note: Display-only positioning lens — flow is never scored into an allocation signal. Velocity = net-flow rate standardized against the series' own trailing norm; acceleration = its 2nd derivative.
